title: Grandma's All-Day Stew vs. a Closet-Sized Kitchen 🦃 | Verdict Picks Toon Ep.7 #Shorts
description:
Thanksgiving in a closet-sized kitchen. Every burner is full, and Grandma June's bean stew "simmers all day."
Then Jo finds last Christmas's gift, still in its box.

Verdict Picks Toon, Episode 7. Our full Instant Pot Duo 6-quart review, with the price to wait for and the model-number trap:
https://acts39.blogspot.com/2026/10/instant-pot-duo-6-quart-review-2026.html

Facts in this Short: Instant Pot's own store listed the Duo 6-quart at $109.99, with no discount, on November 17, 2026. Black Friday 2025 took about 36% off (Bob Vila, November 28, 2025); our guide says about $75 or less is the price to wait for. Owners praise its speed and use it as one pot for rice, beans, stews, soup and yogurt (search summary of a Walmart listing, October 5, 2026).
